description: Read one of your Besidka connectors: the summary of list_connectors plus its tools (name, whether it is on, its approval mode and whether the server marks it read-only) and how many times its tools were called in the last 30 days. Tool descriptions are not included. Never returns the full address, keys, tokens or call contents. Requires signing in (connectors:read).
name: get_connector
title: Get a connector
